Operations Control PostureLink

Control FieldCurrent StandardFounder Use
Layer statusActive execution, movement, and proof-custody layerUse this hub when a decision affects shipment movement, broker handoff, supplier payment, packet release, or operational custody.
Primary purposeConnect active shipments, release gates, funding gates, document packets, supplier instructions, working files, and closeout proof.Gives the founder one safe-movement map before execution widens.
Source ruleUpdate shipment rooms, release records, funding records, document-control packets, supplier packets, working files, and dashboards first, then refresh summary views.Prevents operating confidence from outrunning source proof.
Decision ruleDo not treat packet completeness, supplier urgency, customer pressure, or commercial momentum as movement approval unless release, funding, executable-check, document, and containment records carry the same answer.Keeps movement permission evidence-backed.
Protection ruleKeep working copies out of protected templates and route settled proof into governed custody.Preserves approved masters while live execution matures.

Movement Permission GatesLink

GatePass StandardIf Not Passed
Release gatePre-shipment release, executable-check board, scenario response, risk register, and shipment room carry the same current answer.Hold broker handoff, forwarder release, and ETD-ready status.
Funding gateFunding release, funding dashboard, cash outlook, release gate, packet proof, and executable-check record agree.Hold supplier settlement, freight, broker, duty, clearance, or shipment-linked cash.
Packet gateDocument control, supplier packet, traceability, and shipment review are current and bounded.Do not use clean-looking documents as movement authority.
Supplier response gateSupplier receipt, document review, execution confirmation, trust posture, and supply resilience are current.Keep supplier communication narrow and do not compress release decisions.
Traceability gateTraceability room, document packet, compliance dashboard, claim/CAPA records, and shipment review support the same proof boundary.Keep filing, challenge-defense, recovery, and FDA readiness confidence bounded.
Closeout gateShipment review, document control, task room, executable-check board, and archive route can reconstruct the final story.Keep active custody and block archive finality.

Protection and Escalation RulesLink

TriggerRequired ActionFounder Protection
Packet completeness is used as release authorityRoute back through pre-shipment release, executable-check board, and document control before action.Separates proof from permission.
Funding, release, packet, scenario, or risk records divergeHold movement and run control-integrity review before widening.Prevents same-day pressure from creating conflicting operating truth.
Supplier timing compresses the release windowRefresh supplier release packet, response escalation, and supply resilience before confirming wider action.Prevents late supplier response from forcing rushed payment or broker decisions.
Traceability or compliance confidence widens while evidence gaps remainKeep confidence bounded and refresh traceability, compliance, document control, and shipment review.Protects challenge-defense and regulator credibility.
Temporary support files remain in working files after owner and destination are knownMove settled proof into shipment, document-control, compliance, CRM, dashboard, or archive custody.Prevents hidden source of truth.
Closeout or archive is requested before proof is retrievableKeep active custody and require shipment review plus archive closeout routing.Stops archive finality from outrunning evidence.
